description: Create or update a scaling policy for an Auto Scaling Group. A new policyName creates a policy; to update, pass policyNo or the existing policyName.

adjustmentTypeCode.description: Adjustment type: CHANG (add/remove N servers), PRCNT (change by N percent), EXACT (set capacity to N). See ncloud_get_adjustment_types.

minAdjustmentStep.description: Minimum adjustment step (servers). Only valid with adjustmentTypeCode=PRCNT.

policyName.description: Policy name (1-255 chars: lowercase letters, digits, '-'). A new name creates a policy; an existing name updates it. One of policyNo / policyName is required.

policyNo.description: Policy number to update (from ncloud_list_scaling_policies). Omit when creating.

scalingAdjustment.description: Adjustment value: CHANG ≥ -2147483648, PRCNT ≥ -100, EXACT ≥ 0; negative values scale in for CHANG/PRCNT

name: ncloud_put_scaling_policy
